article.headline: Fastenal Edges To New High As Quarterly Sales Climb 15.5%
article.deck: Fastenal sits at 55.53, near the top of the buy range from its 53.02 flat-base buy point, which runs to 55.67.
body: Fastenal rose 0.69, or 1.3%, to 55.53 as of 1:12 p.m. Mountain, a cent under its 52-week high of 55.54 and a new high on the desk's read. The stock broke out Nov. 4 from a 12-week flat base 10.6% deep, with a buy point of 53.02 and a buy range up to 55.67. It now trades 4.7% past the buy point. The session is on pace for 0.34x its 50-day average volume; the breakout session traded 1.48x.

Five sessions after the breakout the trend is orderly. The stock is 1.5 ATRs from the 21-day line at 52.72 and 8.9% above its 50-day line at 50.99. Its RS rank is 79 of 99 on the desk's list, with the RS line 0.1% off its high. Fastenal is up 38.4% this year and 34.3% over the past year.

The September quarter brought EPS of 0.35, up 20.7%, on revenue of $2.46 billion, up 15.5%. EPS has risen each quarter in the table, from 0.26 to 0.30 to 0.33 to 0.35, and revenue from $2.03 billion to $2.46 billion. The market pays 39.3 times forward earnings for a company worth about $63.7 billion. The next report is due Jan. 19, 2027.

The industrial distributor has company at the top of its group. A Nov. 4 headline had rival Grainger surging on its best revenue growth in five years, and Grainger sits 4.5% past its own flat-base buy point on the desk's breakout list.
A move past 55.67 puts Fastenal above the buy range and makes the entry a chase.
article.watch: Watch the 55.67 top of the buy range above and the 53.02 buy point below.

article.headline: Zeta Global Jumps 7.7% After Third-Quarter Beat And Higher Outlook
article.deck: One day after clearing a 34.90 cup buy point, Zeta is extended past the 36.65 top of its buy range; the entry is gone until a new base or a pullback.
body: Zeta Global rose 2.69, or 7.7%, to 37.76 as of 1:12 p.m. Mountain, the day after it broke out of a five-week cup 15.6% deep. The buy point is 34.90 and the buy range ran to 36.65; the stock now sits 8.2% past the buy point and above the range. The session is on pace for 1.39x its 50-day average volume; the Nov. 10 breakout traded 1.92x.

The stock is 1.8% below its 52-week high of 38.46. It is 1.67 ATRs from the 21-day line at 32.76 and 18.3% above its 50-day line at 31.93, so the trend is intact but the price has left the buy range behind. Its RS rank is 99 of 99 on the desk's list, and the RS line is at a new high. Zeta is up 85.6% this year and 89.8% over the past year.

The September quarter brought EPS of 0.14 on revenue of $492.7 million, up 46.1%. EPS in the earlier quarters in the table ran 0.03, minus 0.06 and 0.03, and revenue has climbed each quarter from $394.6 million. The market values the company at about $9.66 billion and 28.1 times forward earnings.

Zeta reported Nov. 9. Zacks headlines said third-quarter earnings and revenue beat estimates and that the call highlighted AI growth and a higher outlook. A Simply Wall St. headline said the stock jumped on the quarter and a profit turn.
A pullback toward 34.90 or the 21-day line would put the stock back near a level the chart supports.
article.watch: Watch whether Zeta holds above the 34.90 buy point on any pullback toward the 21-day line.

article.headline: BlackRock Holds Near High As Its Bitcoin Fund Draws Inflows
article.deck: BlackRock trades 0.8% past the 1,220.04 buy point of a 53-week cup, inside a buy range that runs to 1,281.04.
body: BlackRock rose 7.17, or 0.6%, to 1,229.32 as of 1:12 p.m. Mountain. The stock broke out Nov. 4 from a 53-week cup 24.8% deep, with a buy point of 1,220.04 and a buy range up to 1,281.04. It sits 0.8% past the buy point, at the low end of the range. The session is on pace for 0.57x its 50-day average volume; the breakout session traded 1.77x.

Five sessions after the breakout the stock is 1.0% below its 52-week high of 1,242.12. It is 1.82 ATRs from the 21-day line at 1,163.24 and 10.8% above its 50-day line at 1,109.28. Its RS rank is 72 of 99 on the desk's list, and the RS line is 3.8% below its high, lagging the price. BlackRock is up 14.9% this year and 13.5% over the past year.

The September quarter brought EPS of 10.57, up 25.4%, on revenue of $7.75 billion, up 19.1%. The quarters before ran uneven, with EPS of 12.19, 14.06 and 7.16, and revenue of $7.08 billion, $6.70 billion and $7.01 billion. The market values the firm at about $189.8 billion and 18.96 times forward earnings. The next report is due Jan. 14, 2027.
A Simply Wall St. headline Wednesday said BlackRock drew bitcoin inflows as safety fears met its AI and Canada push, while another headline said bitcoin ETF outflows continued as crypto prices sank.
A close back under 1,220.04 would turn the breakout into a stalled one.
article.watch: Watch the 1,220.04 buy point; a close below it stalls the breakout.
